_comment: The stock words that a classifier reads as machine-made. Each entry is a word that a language model reaches for because it is the safe choice, and a list of replacements that carry the same meaning in the same grammatical slot. The stage that uses this bank is deterministic and always fires, because these are the words that move the signal most and the swaps that are safest. A word is left alone when it is part of a hyphenated compound such as 'robust-augmented', when it is capitalised inside a sentence, or when the swap would create a stock phrase that the audit would flag.
